svg.title: Khooneh 1405 · kitchen A · 1:20
svg.text: Khooneh · design 1405 · kitchen of home A (F1 a-kitchen) · 1:20 on A1

Plan: symbols cut at 1.1 m, zones (dots), the cook's strip (tinted), the things on the worktop and rail. Elevations: modules by code (D1-D3 drawers, B base, SB sink base, W1-W2 wall units, O open shelf dashed, L larder), worktop at 0.90 m. From scenarios-ai.json (the kitchen plan on the picks). The AI's proposal, not checked by an engineer.
